note: Existing-corpus rows whose request carries a sampling instruction: how finely to read inside the window. Under the reviewer's ruling (PR #230 follow-up, Q2), a tool that does not declare and execute sampling must ASK on these, so their expected outcome under a no-sampling tool profile is 'ask', whatever their meaning label says about the window. Written before the complete-meaning re-run. 'write ops per second per node' is NOT here: 'per second' is part of that metric's name. Rows that keep only part of each period ('of each hour') are restrictions, not sampling, and are labelled ask already. In the held-out set, the class 'sampling-cadence' marks the same thing; that file is not edited.
